title: 🚀 Boost your Copilot: Real-Time Access to Official Microsoft Learn 🚀
summary: The Microsoft Learn Docs MCP server enables developers to access real-time official Microsoft documentation within GitHub Copilot and IDEs in agent mode. It provides accurate, up-to-date information during Business Central development by connecting AI tools directly to Microsoft Learn.
key_points: The Microsoft Learn Docs MCP server lets AI assistants search and retrieve official Microsoft documentation through the endpoint https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp
In VS Code it is enabled by adding a server entry with that URL to mcp.json
Once Copilot runs in agent mode, the microsoft_docs_search tool becomes available
An example prompt asks how to query the Business Central catalog for business event definitions
Coverage is planned to grow to more Microsoft documentation sources with better query understanding

quotes.text: We'll have answers and suggestions based on the most up-to-date Microsoft documentation, right in our development environment.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the key benefit of eliminating training data cutoff limitations during development
